title: prior diffusion models not shown capable of high-quality samples
description: Before this work, diffusion probabilistic models had not been demonstrated to generate high-quality samples comparable to GANs, autoregressive models, flows, or VAEs.
canonical_description: diffusion models not shown capable of generating high quality samples

evidence.quote: Diffusion models are straightforward to define and efficient to train, but to the best of our knowledge, there has been no demonstration that they are capable of generating high quality samples.
